verdict.rationale: Chroma's first-party docs say it handles embedding automatically at ingest. They also say you can query with raw query texts, which implies embedding at query time. The embedding model is customizable across providers such as OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face and sentence-transformers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of built-in embedding, and detailed docs on how providers are configured (keys, defaults, per-collection settings).

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: Chroma will store your text and handle embedding and indexing automatically. You can also customize the embedding model.
You can query the collection with a list of query texts, and Chroma will return the n most similar results.
Use any embedding model. OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face, sentence-transformers, and more.
